name: Dorogaya Alisa
source: The protagonist, Artyom, who has fallen head over heels in love with Alisa, suddenly finds himself in the place he's been wanting so much. What will he do now, what actions will he take, and how will the camp react?
translation: 主角Artyom深深地爱上了Alisa，突然发现自己身处他一直渴望的地方。他现在会做什么，会采取什么行动，营地会如何反应？
